description: Spend stress to add a bonus die to a failed or partial roll (default: 2 stress for +1d6; the world's stressConfig can change both). Can trigger trauma if stress exceeds max. Returns an envelope with `outcome` ('pushed' or 'trauma_gained') and a one-line `summary` as the headline; mechanical detail is in `result` (including `previousOutcome` → `newOutcome`, the re-derived outcome tier for the pushed margin), stress/trauma changes in `state_delta`. Not available in worlds that don't spend stress (mechanics.fitd.stressSpends).

originalNatural.description: The original die, before modifiers. With it, a roll the world's always-fail band failed is refused (a push can't rescue it), and the outcomes use the world's critical rules.

originalRoll.description: The original roll total to add bonus to

name: push_roll
